newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells stake in local trading firm.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells stake in local trading firm.

text.p: Croatia's state privatisation agency, the Croatian Privatisation Fund, sold its 18.6-percent stake in local trading firm Zadar dd, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported.
At a cash auction of remaining holdings in mostly privatised companies, it sold 6,714 shares in Zadar at 100 German marks face value each. The buyer was I.C.F. brokerage.
The fund offered for sale stakes ranging between 0.67 and one third of equity in 11 other companies, but they drew no interest from investors.
Similar discount auctions held each Monday have also failed to arouse larger buying interest in months.

Most attractive assets from the state portfolio worth over 18 billion kuna were recently set aside for mass privatisation. They will be available from autumn in exchange for free vouchers to an estimated 350,000 beneficiaries of the scheme.
